features.fullDescription: Archibald Simpson 1835-6. Perpendicular gothic, harled with granite dressings. 5-bay main rectangle with lancets, narrower 'chancel' entrance bay with tracened S window and bellcote at apex of gable. Simple distinctive treatment. 1836 Blaikie bell.
